references.text: Eliasaf, son of Reuel (also called Deuel), is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Gad during the census.
Eliasaf, son of Deuel, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Gad at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Eliasaf, son of Deuel, led the army of the tribe of Gad during the wilderness journey.
Gad was a son of Jacob and Zilpah, and this verse tells about his birth and naming.
Jacob's blessing over the tribe of Gad, which prophesies about the tribe's future.
